_readme: Single source of truth for AdMob IDs. 'test' = Google's public sample IDs, used by debug/profile builds (and release builds made with --dart-define=ARCLOOM_TEST_ADS=true for ad units). 'release' = production IDs, used only by release builds. Consumed by android/app/build.gradle.kts (app ID manifest placeholder), tool/sync_admob_config.dart (iOS xcconfig) and lib/config/ad_config.dart (ad units). Values containing REPLACE are treated as not configured and ads stay disabled on that platform.
